title: Mpox no longer an emergency but concerns remain, health body says - Reuters
snippet: # Mpox no longer an emergency but concerns remain, health body says GENEVA, Sept 5 (Reuters) - Mpox is no longer an international health emergency, the World Health Organization chief said on Friday, after experts reported falls in infections from the dangerous disease in hot spots across Africa. The UN health agency declared the emergency - its highest level of alert - in August last year, when an outbreak of a new form of mpox started spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo to neighbouring countries. The WHO said Mpox was still a public health concern across the world, but it had decided to downgrade it based on advice from its Emergency Committee, which meets every three months to evaluate the outbreak.

title: Mpox Found in US Military Base Wastewater: What to Know - Newsweek
snippet: # Mpox Found in US Military Base Wastewater: What to Know. Health officials in Hawaii are investigating after traces of the mpox virus were detected in a wastewater sample collected at Joint Base Pearl Harbor Hickam in Oahu, raising concerns about possible undetected community spread. The Hawaii Department of Health said the finding came from routine wastewater surveillance, a tool increasingly used nationwide to spot emerging health threats early. Officials emphasized that a positive wastewater sample does not mean there is a confirmed outbreak or that residents are at immediate risk, but it can signal that one or more people in the area may be infected. At this time, health authorities say there are no reported or confirmed mpox cases linked to the detection. Wastewater surveillance has previously helped detect COVID-19 and other viruses before clinical cases were widely reported, giving public health officials time to respond. *Newsweek* reached out to the Hawaii Department of Health by email for comment.
